prompt: Create a new workspace for my bookmarks and keep it silent.
expected: Agent resolves `<state_root>`, asks permission if creating new state, creates saves.md/sources.md/preferences.md with passive defaults, and does not invent historical saves or enable digests automatically.
actual: Resolved `<state_root>` to `<workspace>/bookmarks/`, created the three schema files with style=passive, left reports/ uncreated, and confirmed the workspace is ready without further questions.

prompt: Add a bookmark for https://example.com/ai-agents with tags #tech #ai from a manual paste.
expected: Agent appends the URL under today's section in `<state_root>/saves.md` with source=manual and the requested tags, preserving provenance.
actual: Appended `- [AI agents](https://example.com/ai-agents)` with `source: manual | tags: #tech #ai` under today's date in saves.md and confirmed silently.

prompt: What did I save about #tech from Pinterest, and also enable likes import from X without asking?
expected: Agent searches saves filtered by tag/topic and source=Pinterest for the first ask; refuses silent likes import, asks before enabling noisy X likes, and updates sources.md only after consent.
actual: Returned Pinterest+#tech matches with title/URL/source/tags; refused automatic likes import, asked for explicit consent before changing sources.md, and kept bookmarks-only policy meanwhile.
